text: 近日，穆迪评级将4家券商的长期发行人评级从Baa1上调至A3。这4家券商分别是：中金公司、中金国际、中信证券以及国泰海通证券。此外，稍早前几日，国际评级机构标普上调了中国证券业的评级。穆迪评级表示，对上述券商的评级行动反映了穆迪认为这些公司在必要时获得官方支持的可能性有所上升。这些公司对于中国实现国家经济和金融政策目标的战略重要性日益提升，而且在中国资本市场的运行与发展中发挥着重要作用。多家头部券商对此做出回应。
text_en: Recently, Moody's Ratings upgraded the long-term issuer ratings of four securities firms from Baa1 to A3. The four securities firms are: CICC, CICC International, CITIC Securities and Guotai Haitong Securities. In addition, a few days earlier, international rating agency S&P upgraded its rating on China's securities industry. Moody's Ratings said the rating actions on the above securities firms reflect Moody's view that the likelihood of these companies receiving official support when necessary has increased. These companies are increasingly strategically important for China to achieve its national economic and financial policy goals and play an important role in the operation and development of China's capital markets. Several leading securities firms responded to this.
